'''Lapidarian Highlands''' (Japanese: '''ギプナ高地''' ''Guipna Highlands'') is an {{pkmn|animated series}}-exclusive location in the [[Pokémon world]]. It was mentioned in ''[[XY028|The Bonds of Evolution!]]''. {{an|Professor Sycamore}} described it as "one of the last unexplored regions in the world."

[[Diantha]] was filming a movie in the Lapidarian Highlands when a thick fog rose, and she got lost from her crew. She had entrusted her manager, [[Kathi Lee]], with her {{TP|Diantha|Gardevoir}}. As Diantha's crew went searching for her, Gardevoir came out of its {{i|Poké Ball}}. By connecting its heart with Diantha's, it was able to guide the crew to Diantha's location.
